scope: Opt-in selected fixed XRECORD source evidence for one completed DWG import. No DWG replay, DXF output, graph closure, native acceptance or semantic support qualification.
oda_specification: ODA v5.4.1 section 20.1 describes non-entity MS byte size, versioned handle stream framing, final CRC, and CRC coverage including size bytes; section 2.14.1 describes the two-byte, byte-aligned CRC. XRECORD observations and ODA/peer string-length disagreement remain in p5-ac1018-table-xrecord-source-wire-2026-11-11.json.
design: The optional sink selects one handle; reader re-reads the selected post-lease OBJECTS frame using DwgObjectFrame::readAt, stages at most one body, and limits its encoded size to 1 MiB before the second frame allocation. Candidate staging exceptions are caught and disable this optional observation.

Only dwgRW can invoke the private reader delivery after processDwg succeeds; the reader requires zero entity/object parse failures, complete frame coverage and no coverage integrity violation. It moves the candidate out before issuing a noncopyable reader-created ticket.

The adapter snapshots one raw carrier and publication, with a 2 MiB aggregate estimate ceiling, and records its exact starting per-import token and generation. After whole read it seals only if the raw/publication identity and bytes match and the existing raw reparse matched an immutable typed baseline.

Live validation compares token, generation, source profile, complete retained raw/publication fields, baseline identity, unique typed handle and modeled XRECORD state. All three value views are checked; normal XRECORD ordered-value authority and ordinary DRW_Interface callbacks remain unchanged.
An unknown XRECORD codepage does not prevent bounded source evidence. It does not establish character semantics or authorize output.

generated_ac1018: Two independently imported identical handle/offset profiles receive distinct import tokens; swapping capability refuses.
Changed source body and source ordinal refuse; modeled cloning, ordered entries, legacy scalar view and handle view mutations refuse; duplicate model handle refuses; restoration retries successfully.
Wrong selection yields no source; default opt-out import remains readable with the same XRECORD count and object failure count.

A callback throws on a later generated XRECORD after the selected one; object failure is observed and no capability seals. Same-interface and cross-interface same-data nested import both refuse source evidence. Failed reimport invalidates the old evidence and a fresh retry succeeds.
generated_ac1015: Independently assembled object frame accepts good CRC, rejects damaged CRC and accepts restored CRC.

Generated whole-file AC1015 uses a checked physical source offset and exact matching source body. Flipping only the selected object stored CRC yields no capability; restoring the CRC permits the same reader to retry with fresh aggregate.
focused_validation.limitations: No exhaustive allocation-failure injection or oversized selected-frame integration test was run. The CRC control verifies source-frame admission; it does not establish whole-file integrity or semantic correctness. Generated controls do not qualify native producers. No writer staging, writer retry, or output CRC regeneration exists in this slice.

physical_observation.source: ODA 27.1 audited AC1018 recreation from ezdxf acad_table_simple.dxf
physical_observation.result: read=true; unchanged selected source capability=true; 226/226 source frames published; zero entity/object failures
physical_observation.remaining: A HEADER offset integrity observation remains; TABLECONTENT 0xb9, TABLEGEOMETRY 0xba and DATATABLE 0xbd remain raw-only. Physical TABLE subtree output remains refused.
